_comment: Idea #24 numpad editor — `overrides[]` moves EXISTING placed refs (the sibling of `removals[]`: remove existing / move existing). Each entry re-stamps position/rotation (degrees, full new transform not a delta) on a ref another plugin authored, via GetOrAddAsOverride; the parent cell/worldspace comes along automatically. `scale` omitted = keep the record's original scale; 1.0 = reset to engine default. This example nudges Skulvar's hoe at the Whiterun stables (same guinea-pig ref as the removals demo) 64 units up and spins it flat.
